evaluation_cohort: IDRiD Official Disease Grading Testing Set (103 scans)

0.name: No Apparent DME Risk Features
0.description: No apparent hard exudates within the macular boundary.

1.name: Moderate DME Risk Category
1.description: Hard exudates present within macular region, but > 1 disc diameter from the foveal center.

2.name: High DME Risk Category (Hard Exudates within 1 DD of Fovea)
2.description: Hard exudates present within 1 disc diameter of the foveal center according to IDRiD criteria.

csme_high_risk_triage.definition: High Risk DME Category (Grade 2 vs Grades 0, 1) using binary decision threshold P(Grade 2) >= 0.50

threshold_reconciliation.argmax_vs_threshold_explanation: Argmax 3-class classification assigns the highest softmax probability even if below 0.50. Under argmax, TP=41 (85.42% sensitivity) and FP=16 (70.91% specificity). Under the binary decision threshold P(Grade 2)>=0.50, one borderline positive (IDRiD_012, p2=0.4808) is not assigned high-risk (TP=40, sensitivity=83.33%), and two borderline negatives (IDRiD_006, p2=0.4932; IDRiD_054, p2=0.4933) are classified negative, reducing FP to 14 (TN=41, specificity=74.55%).
